- Learned a lot and got great advice from professionals in the music industry; found it inspiring [S3T5].

- On 2023-05-31, caught up with Calvin ("been ages since we chatted"); congratulated Calvin on the Frank Ocean tour (Tokyo stop; details in /memories/calvin.md) [S7T1][S7T2]. Shared a photo of himself fixing a neighbor's car engine in a garage (details in ## Car maintenance shop) and told Calvin that working on cars is "definitely therapeutic"; Calvin said fixing cars calms him down "like meditating" and asked whether Dave has hobbies with the same satisfaction — Dave described his passion for fixing up things as more than a hobby, giving purpose and a sense of achievement (details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S7T2][S7T4][S7T5][S7T6]. The exchange ended with the two agreeing that transforming something and giving it a new life makes them feel like they "really achieved something" [S7T7][S7T8]. The 2023-05-31 conversation continued: Calvin echoed the "feeling of power and happiness" ("It's great to see what we created with all our hard work and ideas") [S7T9]; Dave asked whether Calvin always enjoys performing live (Calvin: it "always fuels my soul" — an "absolute high") [S7T10][S7T11], and Dave marveled at the artist-audience connection and the concert crowd photos Calvin shared (a large crowd taking pictures; a crowd watching a concert with bright lights; a band on stage), calling the atmosphere "off the charts" and saying music "brings people together ... like therapy for us all" [S7T12][S7T13][S7T14]; when Dave asked what's next for Calvin's music, Calvin named the Boston stop on the Frank Ocean tour, and Dave said he'll be there to cheer him on (details in ## Boston) [S7T14][S7T15][S7T16]. The conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave for his support and saying he can't wait to experience the Boston music scene; Dave wished Calvin a great time in Boston and said he can't wait to hear all about it when he gets back, and Calvin promised to fill him in on all the details, signing off "See you soon!" [S7T17][S7T18][S7T19].
- On 2023-04-20, continued the catch-up: offered to show Calvin around Boston (Paradise Rock, House of Blues, Fenway Park), said he'll be in the front row when Calvin performs, and agreed to grab food at his favorite spots when Calvin visits (details in ## Boston) [S3T10][S3T15][S3T16]. Calvin shared a photo of his red sports car on display at a show, and Dave praised the work put into it [S3T13][S3T14].

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- How it came about: he met Frank Ocean at a music festival in Tokyo and they clicked; they've been speaking and sharing ideas, arranged a meeting, and Calvin recorded a song in the studio at his mansion (the mansion he is turning into a recording studio, see ## Recording studio (2023-07-21)) — "it's been great!" [S15T4]. (This may be the Tokyo music festival he attended on 2023-04-20 — see ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20) — but that is not confirmed.)
- On that festival: the city was "buzzing with energy" and the festival crowd was "so lively" — "it was like fuel for my soul"; he called the experience "a dream come true" — "The festival had buzzing energy and a super upbeat crowd. We all felt connected, it was amazing!"; shared a photo of the crowd (people sitting on the grass at night) [S15T6][S15T8].
- How it started — Calvin's account on 2023-10-19: "It all started August last year" (i.e., August 2022) when he and Frank Ocean met at a festival and Frank said he wanted to collaborate — "We clicked right away and the chemistry on stage was incredible. I'm so lucky!" This is a later, more specific account than the 2023-08-22 one (a Tokyo music festival, possibly the one he attended on 2023-04-20 — see ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20)); the two accounts differ on when/where they met (August 2022 festival vs. a 2023 Tokyo festival) — both kept. [S24T5]
- On 2023-10-19, shared photos while telling Dave about the tour: of how he performed on stage (a photo of a band performing on stage with bright lights — "that was awesome!"), of him and Frank Ocean together on stage (a photo of a band performing on stage with a projection of a man on the wall — "we perfectly look together on stage"), and of the audience (a photo of a large crowd of people in a large auditorium — "Look at this crowd, that was insane!") [S24T1][S24T5][S24T7].

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-05-31, said working on cars is "definitely therapeutic" and that it is not difficult for him to help neighbors with their cars [S7T4].
- Passionate about fixing up things in general: "more than just a hobby" — it gives him a sense of achievement and purpose [S7T6].
- Gets "a real buzz" transforming something that's not working into something that runs smoothly — "like giving it a second chance" [S7T6].
- Giving something a new life "makes [him] feel powerful and happy — like [he] really achieved something"; he agreed with Calvin that they both "take something and make it look amazing" [S7T7][S7T8].
- On 2023-08-03, said fixing cars is like therapy for him; growing up he worked on cars with his dad, and refurbishing them gives him a sense of fulfillment [S12T2].
- On 2023-09-02, when telling Calvin he's been tied up with car stuff, said fixing stuff up and seeing it turn out better is "really rewarding and gives me a sense of purpose", and that fixing someone's car makes him feel like he's "making a difference"; he's made "proud" to see the relief on someone's face when their car is fixed (echoing his long-stated sense of purpose from fixing things, see above) [S17T3][S17T5].
- Has fond memories of working on cars with his dad as a kid: they spent one summer restoring an old car — "It was hard work, but seeing the end result and knowing that we did it together was really satisfying" [S12T4].
- Shared a photo from that time: a man and a child (Dave and his dad) posing for a picture — "a wonderful experience" [S12T6].
- On 2023-09-15, told Calvin (answering whether it's satisfying to see his hard work pay off, on the restoration finished that day — context in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) that "It's so satisfying to see this brought back to life," especially seeing people's reactions when they see the finished product — "makes all the hard work worth it" [S19T9].
